title: SG-6.1.3 Validate scene characters against the world's character list
summary: Reject scene characters whose id is not in the world's character list, with a path-tagged issue
description: Context: validateWorld in game/src/content/loader.ts checks dialogue speakers and say events against world.characters, but never checks scene.characters (SceneDef.characters?: CharacterSpec[]). Desired behavior: each scene character id is checked against the world's list and unknown ids are reported as scenes[<sceneId>].characters[<index>].id: unknown character <id>. Expected result: dangling NPC references fail world content validation, and unit tests cover the reject and accept cases. Why: scene NPCs must reference declared world characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene character whose id is not in world.characters, when validateWorld runs, then the errors contain scenes[<sceneId>].characters[<index>].id: unknown character <id>
Given a scene whose characters are all in world.characters, when validateWorld runs, then no character error is reported
Given the unit tests in game/tests/validator.test.ts, when they run, then the reject and accept cases pass with every dependency mocked

preserve: existing unknown character message format for dialogue speakers and say events

technical_constraints: Reuse the existing characters Set in validateWorld
Do not change the error strings that already exist
definition_of_done: Unknown scene character ids are reported with the path-tagged message
